source_name: Trade-data aggregator compilations (seair.co.in, tradeimex.in) citing APEDA/DGCI&S-derived figures; year attribution imprecise in sources checked
notes: CAUTION — DGFT POLICY IS VOLATILE FOR THIS PRODUCT: as of the August 2026 check, onion exports are 'Free' but subject to a Minimum Export Price (~$550/MT) and a 20% export duty; India banned onion exports outright for ~6 months in 2023-24 (HS 0703 10 19 moved to 'Prohibited' until 31 Mar 2024) and has changed policy with little notice historically. Any onion page or blog post must say pricing/duty terms are confirmed at time of order, not quoted as fixed. On the data itself: aggregate FY figure cited was ~1,147,721.91 MT / ~USD 453.95 million, but the source blended what appear to be FY2024-25 and FY2025-26 references without clearly separating them — treat the total-year figure as indicative only. The three per-country values above were stated without an explicit year in the source; verify against APEDA's Fresh Onions page (apeda.gov.in/FreshOnions) before using precise dollar figures in a published blog post. Export duty on onions was removed 1 April 2025 per one source; MEP is a separate, still-active control as of the August 2026 search.
